```{r}

# 1) PCA-based hotspot indices for macro- and micronutrients


run_hotspot_index <- function(data, vars, group_label, title_prefix,
                              min_explained = 0.80) {

  vars <- intersect(vars, names(data))

  dat_index <- data %>%
    select(sample_type, nesting_site, all_of(vars)) %>%
    drop_na()

  X_index <- dat_index %>%
    select(all_of(vars)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), log1p)) %>%
    as.matrix()

  X_index <- X_index[, apply(X_index, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  vars_used <- colnames(X_index)
  X_index_scaled <- scale(X_index)

  pca_index <- prcomp(X_index_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

  prop_var <- (pca_index$sdev^2) / sum(pca_index$sdev^2)
  cum_var <- cumsum(prop_var)

  k <- which(cum_var >= min_explained)[1]
  if (is.na(k)) k <- length(prop_var)

  pc_cols <- paste0("PC", seq_len(k))

  pc_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_index$x[, seq_len(k), drop = FALSE])
  colnames(pc_scores) <- pc_cols

  dat_index_pca <- bind_cols(
    dat_index %>% select(sample_type, nesting_site),
    pc_scores
  )

  weights <- prop_var[seq_len(k)]
  weights <- weights / sum(weights)

  pc_mat <- as.matrix(dat_index_pca %>% select(all_of(pc_cols)))
  control_idx <- which(dat_index_pca$sample_type == "control")
  control_centroid <- colMeans(pc_mat[control_idx, , drop = FALSE])

  diffs2 <- (pc_mat - matrix(control_centroid, nrow = nrow(pc_mat), ncol = k, byrow = TRUE))^2
  index_dist <- sqrt(diffs2 %*% weights)

  dat_index_pca <- dat_index_pca %>%
    mutate(hotspot_index = as.numeric(index_dist))

  fit_hotspot <- lm(
    hotspot_index ~ sample_type + nesting_site,
    data = dat_index_pca
  )

  hotspot_result <- broom::tidy(fit_hotspot) %>%
    filter(term == "sample_typenest") %>%
    mutate(
      index_type = group_label,
      median_control = median(dat_index_pca$hotspot_index[dat_index_pca$sample_type == "control"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_nest = median(dat_index_pca$hotspot_index[dat_index_pca$sample_type == "nest"], na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = case_when(
        estimate > 0 ~ "higher_in_nest",
        estimate < 0 ~ "lower_in_nest",
        TRUE ~ "no_difference"
      ),
      n_samples = nrow(dat_index_pca),
      n_vars = length(vars_used),
      pcs_retained = k,
      variance_explained = sum(prop_var[seq_len(k)])
    )

  pc1_var <- round(100 * prop_var[1], 1)
  pc2_var <- round(100 * prop_var[2], 1)

  scores_index_2d <- as.data.frame(pca_index$x[, 1:2]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    mutate(
      sample_type = dat_index$sample_type,
      nesting_site = dat_index$nesting_site
    )

  p_pca <- ggplot(scores_index_2d, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      geom = "path",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      type = "norm"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      size = 5.2,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    labs(
      title = paste(title_prefix, "composition"),
      x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "%)")
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal"
    )

  p_index <- ggplot(
    dat_index_pca,
    aes(x = sample_type, y = hotspot_index, colour = sample_type)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(group = sample_type),
      width = 0.52,
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 1.0,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.08,
      size = 4.0,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal_main) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))) +
    labs(
      title = paste(title_prefix, "hotspot index"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Distance from control centroid"
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    )

  list(
    dat = dat_index_pca,
    model = fit_hotspot,
    result = hotspot_result,
    pca_plot = p_pca,
    index_plot = p_index
  )
}

macro_index <- run_hotspot_index(
  data = dat_nc,
  vars = macro_vars,
  group_label = "macro",
  title_prefix = "Macronutrient"
)

micro_index <- run_hotspot_index(
  data = dat_nc,
  vars = micro_vars,
  group_label = "micro",
  title_prefix = "Micronutrient"
)

write_csv(macro_index$dat, "Table_macronutrient_hotspot_index_per_sample_2024.csv")
write_csv(micro_index$dat, "Table_micronutrient_hotspot_index_per_sample_2024.csv")
write_csv(macro_index$result, "Table_macronutrient_hotspot_index_model_2024.csv")
write_csv(micro_index$result, "Table_micronutrient_hotspot_index_model_2024.csv")
```

```{r}
# 2) Match ITS samples to nutrient data

normalize_sample_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    stringr::str_remove("(-ITS|_ITS)$") %>%
    stringr::str_remove("(-16S|_16S)$")
}

strip_year_prefix <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    normalize_sample_name() %>%
    stringr::str_remove("^[0-9]{4}-")
}

meta_ITS <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_ITS_final), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ps_rowname")

# passende Spalte wählen

  c("sample_name", "nest_ID", "slbez", "sample_id", "label") %in% names(meta_ITS)
][1]

if (is.na(id_col_ITS)) {
  stop("No suitable ITS sample ID column found in metadata.")
}

cat("Using ITS ID column:", id_col_ITS, "\n")

meta_ITS <- meta_ITS %>%
  mutate(
    sample_name_raw = .data[[id_col_ITS]],
    sample_name_join = strip_year_prefix(sample_name_raw)
```

```{r}

# dbRDA: nutrient gradients explaining ITS community structure


library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

set.seed(123)


# 1) Match ITS samples to nutrient data


normalize_sample_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_trim() %>%
    stringr::str_remove("(-ITS|_ITS)$") %>%
    stringr::str_remove("(-16S|_16S)$")
}

strip_year_prefix <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    normalize_sample_name() %>%
    stringr::str_remove("^[0-9]{4}-")
}

meta_ITS <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_ITS_final), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ps_rowname")

id_col_ITS <- c("sample_name", "nest_ID", "slbez", "sample_id", "label")[
  c("sample_name", "nest_ID", "slbez", "sample_id", "label") %in% names(meta_ITS)
][1]

if (is.na(id_col_ITS)) {
  stop("No suitable ITS sample ID column found in metadata.")
}

cat("Using ITS ID column:", id_col_ITS, "\n")

meta_ITS <- meta_ITS %>%
  mutate(
    sample_name_raw = .data[[id_col_ITS]],
    sample_name_join = strip_year_prefix(sample_name_raw)
  )

nutrient_full_ITS <- dat_nc %>%
  mutate(
    sample_name_raw = slbez,
    sample_name_join = strip_year_prefix(sample_name_raw)
  ) %>%
  select(
    sample_name_raw,
    sample_name_join,
    sample_type,
    nesting_site,
    all_of(intersect(c(macro_vars, micro_vars), names(dat_nc)))
  )

otu_mat_ITS <- as(otu_table(ps_ITS_final), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_ITS_final)) {
  otu_mat_ITS <- t(otu_mat_ITS)
}

otu_df_ITS <- as.data.frame(otu_mat_ITS) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ps_rowname")

comm_df_full_ITS <- otu_df_ITS %>%
  left_join(
    meta_ITS %>% select(ps_rowname, sample_name_join),
    by = "ps_rowname"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    nutrient_full_ITS,
    by = "sample_name_join"
  )

matched_n_ITS <- nrow(comm_df_full_ITS)
cat("Matched ITS samples for nutrient integration:", matched_n_ITS, "\n")

if (matched_n_ITS < 5) {
  stop("Too few ITS samples matched to nutrient data even after harmonizing year prefixes.")
}


# 2) Community matrix + environmental data


comm_full_ITS <- comm_df_full_ITS %>%
  select(-ps_rowname, -sample_name_join, -sample_name_raw, -sample_type, -nesting_site) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# besser nur echte OTUs/ASVs behalten:
taxa_names_ITS <- taxa_names(ps_ITS_final)
comm_full_ITS <- comm_df_full_ITS %>%
  select(any_of(taxa_names_ITS)) %>%
  as.matrix()

keep_full_ITS <- rowSums(comm_full_ITS) > 0
comm_full_ITS <- comm_full_ITS[keep_full_ITS, , drop = FALSE]

env_full_ITS <- comm_df_full_ITS[keep_full_ITS, ] %>%
  select(
    sample_name = sample_name_join,
    sample_type,
    nesting_site,
    all_of(intersect(c(macro_vars, micro_vars), names(comm_df_full_ITS)))
  )

env_full_ITS <- env_full_ITS %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = factor(sample_type),
    nesting_site = factor(nesting_site)
  )

comm_hel_full_ITS <- decostand(comm_full_ITS, method = "hellinger")


# 3) Forward selection: macronutrients


macro_candidates_ITS <- intersect(macro_vars, names(env_full_ITS))

keep_macro_ITS <- complete.cases(env_full_ITS[, c("nesting_site", macro_candidates_ITS), drop = FALSE])
comm_macro_ITS <- comm_hel_full_ITS[keep_macro_ITS, , drop = FALSE]
env_macro_ITS  <- env_full_ITS[keep_macro_ITS, , drop = FALSE]

mod0_macro_ITS <- capscale(
  comm_macro_ITS ~ Condition(nesting_site),
  data = env_macro_ITS,
  distance = "bray"
)

mod1_macro_ITS <- capscale(
  as.formula(
    paste0(
      "comm_macro_ITS ~ ",
      paste(sprintf("log1p(`%s`)", macro_candidates_ITS), collapse = " + "),
      " + Condition(nesting_site)"
    )
  ),
  data = env_macro_ITS,
  distance = "bray"
)

mod_sel_macro_ITS <- ordiR2step(
  mod0_macro_ITS,
  scope = formula(mod1_macro_ITS),
  direction = "forward",
  permutations = 999,
  R2scope = TRUE,
  trace = TRUE
)

anova_macro_overall_ITS <- anova(mod_sel_macro_ITS, permutations = 999)
anova_macro_terms_ITS   <- anova(mod_sel_macro_ITS, by = "margin", permutations = 999)
anova_macro_axes_ITS    <- anova(mod_sel_macro_ITS, by = "axis", permutations = 999)

anova_macro_overall_ITS
anova_macro_terms_ITS
anova_macro_axes_ITS


# 4) Forward selection: micronutrients


micro_candidates_ITS <- intersect(micro_vars, names(env_full_ITS))

keep_micro_ITS <- complete.cases(env_full_ITS[, c("nesting_site", micro_candidates_ITS), drop = FALSE])
comm_micro_ITS <- comm_hel_full_ITS[keep_micro_ITS, , drop = FALSE]
env_micro_ITS  <- env_full_ITS[keep_micro_ITS, , drop = FALSE]

mod0_micro_ITS <- capscale(
  comm_micro_ITS ~ Condition(nesting_site),
  data = env_micro_ITS,
  distance = "bray"
)

mod1_micro_ITS <- capscale(
  as.formula(
    paste0(
      "comm_micro_ITS ~ ",
      paste(sprintf("log1p(`%s`)", micro_candidates_ITS), collapse = " + "),
      " + Condition(nesting_site)"
    )
  ),
  data = env_micro_ITS,
  distance = "bray"
)

mod_sel_micro_ITS <- ordiR2step(
  mod0_micro_ITS,
  scope = formula(mod1_micro_ITS),
  direction = "forward",
  permutations = 999,
  R2scope = TRUE,
  trace = TRUE
)

anova_micro_overall_ITS <- anova(mod_sel_micro_ITS, permutations = 999)
anova_micro_terms_ITS   <- anova(mod_sel_micro_ITS, by = "margin", permutations = 999)
anova_micro_axes_ITS    <- anova(mod_sel_micro_ITS, by = "axis", permutations = 999)

anova_micro_overall_ITS
anova_micro_terms_ITS
anova_micro_axes_ITS


# 5) Plot function


plot_dbrda_selected <- function(mod, env_df, term_table, title_text, palette_values) {
  
  site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(mod, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("row_id")
  colnames(site_scores)[2:3] <- c("CAP1", "CAP2")
  
  site_scores <- site_scores %>%
    mutate(
      sample_type = env_df$sample_type,
      nesting_site = env_df$nesting_site,
      sample_name = env_df$sample_name
    )
  
  bp_raw <- as.data.frame(scores(mod, display = "bp", choices = 1:2)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("variable_raw")
  colnames(bp_raw)[2:3] <- c("CAP1", "CAP2")
  
  bp_raw <- bp_raw %>%
    mutate(
      variable = stringr::str_remove_all(variable_raw, "log1p\\(|\\)")
    )
  
  term_pvals <- as.data.frame(term_table) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(term != "Residual") %>%
    transmute(
      variable = stringr::str_remove_all(term, "log1p\\(|\\)"),
      p_value = .data[["Pr(>F)"]]
    )
  
  bp_scores <- bp_raw %>%
    left_join(term_pvals, by = "variable") %>%
    mutate(
      variable_label = recode(variable, !!!nutrient_labels, .default = variable)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_value), p_value < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(
      CAP1 = CAP1 * 1.15,
      CAP2 = CAP2 * 1.15,
      lab_x = CAP1 * 1.10,
      lab_y = CAP2 * 1.10
    )
  
  eig_vals <- eigenvals(mod)
  axis1 <- round(100 * eig_vals[1] / sum(eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]), 1)
  axis2 <- round(100 * eig_vals[2] / sum(eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]), 1)
  
  ggplot(site_scores, aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      geom = "path",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      type = "norm",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      size = 5.2,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = bp_scores,
      aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1, yend = CAP2),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.20, "cm")),
      linewidth = 0.9,
      colour = "grey30",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_label(
      data = bp_scores,
      aes(x = lab_x, y = lab_y, label = variable_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.8,
      linewidth = 0,
      fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.88),
      colour = "grey15",
      label.r = unit(0.12, "lines"),
      label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines")
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = palette_values) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = paste0("dbRDA1 (", axis1, "%)"),
      y = paste0("dbRDA2 (", axis2, "%)")
    ) +
    theme_pub_ITS +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
}


# 6) ITS plots


p_dbrda_macro_sel_ITS <- plot_dbrda_selected(
  mod = mod_sel_macro_ITS,
  env_df = env_macro_ITS,
  term_table = anova_macro_terms_ITS,
  title_text = "Fungal community constrained by macronutrients",
  palette_values = pal_main_ITS
)

p_dbrda_micro_sel_ITS <- plot_dbrda_selected(
  mod = mod_sel_micro_ITS,
  env_df = env_micro_ITS,
  term_table = anova_micro_terms_ITS,
  title_text = "Fungal community constrained by micronutrients",
  palette_values = pal_main_ITS
)


# 7) Export

write_csv(
  broom::tidy(anova_macro_terms_ITS) %>% clean_names(),
  "Table_dbRDA_ITS_macronutrient_terms_selected_2024.csv"
)

write_csv(
  broom::tidy(anova_micro_terms_ITS) %>% clean_names(),
  "Table_dbRDA_ITS_micronutrient_terms_selected_2024.csv"
)
```

```{r}

# Mechanism (ITS): selected nutrients and reproductive parameters
# sodium, organic nitrogen, and manganese

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(patchwork)

# 1) Prepare analysis data

dat_nc2_ITS <- dat_nc %>%
  mutate(
    nest_depth = to_numeric_comma(nest_depth),
    total_egg_number = to_numeric_comma(total_egg_number),
    egg_number_hatched = to_numeric_comma(egg_number_hatched),
    egg_number_undeveloped = to_numeric_comma(egg_number_undeveloped),
    failure_unknowncause = to_numeric_comma(failure_unknowncause),
    hatching_rate = to_numeric_comma(hatching_rate),
    emergence_rate = to_numeric_comma(emergence_rate),
    failed_eggs = if_else(
      is.na(egg_number_undeveloped) & is.na(failure_unknowncause),
      NA_real_,
      rowSums(cbind(egg_number_undeveloped, failure_unknowncause), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    na = as.numeric(na),
    norg_de = as.numeric(norg_de),
    mn3 = as.numeric(mn3)
  )

dat_nest_ITS <- dat_nc2_ITS %>%
  filter(sample_type == "nest") %>%
  mutate(
    failed_eggs = as.numeric(failed_eggs),
    total_egg_number = as.numeric(total_egg_number),
    nest_depth = as.numeric(nest_depth),
    hatching_rate = as.numeric(hatching_rate),
    emergence_rate = as.numeric(emergence_rate)
  )

# 2) Nutrient–nutrient correlations (optional overview)

cor_na_norg_ITS <- cor.test(
  log1p(dat_nest_ITS$na),
  log1p(dat_nest_ITS$norg_de),
  method = "spearman"
)

cor_na_mn_ITS <- cor.test(
  log1p(dat_nest_ITS$na),
  log1p(dat_nest_ITS$mn3),
  method = "spearman"
)

cor_norg_mn_ITS <- cor.test(
  log1p(dat_nest_ITS$norg_de),
  log1p(dat_nest_ITS$mn3),
  method = "spearman"
)


# 3) Reproductive mechanism models
# failed eggs

fit_na_failed_ITS <- lm(
  log1p(na) ~ failed_eggs + total_egg_number + nest_depth + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest_ITS
)

fit_norg_failed_ITS <- lm(
  log1p(norg_de) ~ failed_eggs + total_egg_number + nest_depth + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest_ITS
)

fit_mn_failed_ITS <- lm(
  log1p(mn3) ~ failed_eggs + total_egg_number + nest_depth + nesting_site,
  data = dat_nest_ITS
)



# 8) Prediction data for failed-eggs figure

make_effect_df_ITS <- function(data, model, nutrient_var, nutrient_label) {
  
  x_seq <- seq(
    min(data$failed_eggs, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data$failed_eggs, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 200
  )
  
  ref_site <- names(sort(table(data$nesting_site), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  
  newdat <- tibble(
    failed_eggs = x_seq,
    total_egg_number = median(data$total_egg_number, na.rm = TRUE),
    nest_depth = median(data$nest_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    nesting_site = factor(ref_site, levels = levels(data$nesting_site))
  )
  
  pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE)
  
  newdat %>%
    mutate(
      fit_link = pred$fit,
      se_link = pred$se.fit,
      fit = exp(fit_link) - 1,
      lwr = exp(fit_link - 1.96 * se_link) - 1,
      upr = exp(fit_link + 1.96 * se_link) - 1,
      nutrient = nutrient_label,
      nutrient_var = nutrient_var
    )
}

pred_na_ITS <- make_effect_df_ITS(
  data = dat_nest_ITS,
  model = fit_na_failed_ITS,
  nutrient_var = "na",
  nutrient_label = "Sodium"
)

pred_norg_ITS <- make_effect_df_ITS(
  data = dat_nest_ITS,
  model = fit_norg_failed_ITS,
  nutrient_var = "norg_de",
  nutrient_label = "Organic nitrogen"
)

pred_mn_ITS <- make_effect_df_ITS(
  data = dat_nest_ITS,
  model = fit_mn_failed_ITS,
  nutrient_var = "mn3",
  nutrient_label = "Manganese"
)


# 9) Raw point data

points_na_ITS <- dat_nest_ITS %>%
  transmute(
    failed_eggs,
    nutrient_value = na,
    nutrient = "Sodium"
  )

points_norg_ITS <- dat_nest_ITS %>%
  transmute(
    failed_eggs,
    nutrient_value = norg_de,
    nutrient = "Organic nitrogen"
  )

points_mn_ITS <- dat_nest_ITS %>%
  transmute(
    failed_eggs,
    nutrient_value = mn3,
    nutrient = "Manganese"
  )

points_all_ITS <- bind_rows(
  points_na_ITS,
  points_norg_ITS,
  points_mn_ITS
)

pred_all_ITS <- bind_rows(
  pred_na_ITS,
  pred_norg_ITS,
  pred_mn_ITS
)


# 10) Plotting function

plot_mechanism_adjusted_ITS <- function(points_df, pred_df, nutrient_name, ylab_text) {
  
  pts <- points_df %>% filter(nutrient == nutrient_name)
  prd <- pred_df %>% filter(nutrient == nutrient_name)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = pts,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, y = nutrient_value),
      colour = unname(pal_main_ITS["nest"]),
      size = 4.6,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = prd,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
      fill = unname(pal_main_ITS["nest"]),
      alpha = 0.14
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = prd,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, y = fit),
      colour = unname(pal_main_ITS["nest"]),
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = nutrient_name,
      x = "Number of undeveloped eggs",
      y = ylab_text
    ) +
    theme_pub_ITS +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    )
}


# 11) Main ITS mechanism figure

p_na_failed_adj_ITS <- plot_mechanism_adjusted_ITS(
  points_df = points_all_ITS,
  pred_df = pred_all_ITS,
  nutrient_name = "Sodium",
  ylab_text = "mg/100g"
)

p_norg_failed_adj_ITS <- plot_mechanism_adjusted_ITS(
  points_df = points_all_ITS,
  pred_df = pred_all_ITS,
  nutrient_name = "Organic nitrogen",
  ylab_text = "mg/100g"
)

p_mn_failed_adj_ITS <- plot_mechanism_adjusted_ITS(
  points_df = points_all_ITS,
  pred_df = pred_all_ITS,
  nutrient_name = "Manganese",
  ylab_text = "mg/100g"
)

p_mechanism_main_ITS <- p_na_failed_adj_ITS | p_norg_failed_adj_ITS | p_mn_failed_adj_ITS

p_mechanism_main_ITS

ggsave(
  "Figure_mechanism_ITS_failed_eggs_selected_nutrients_2024.png",
  p_mechanism_main_ITS,
  width = 17,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
# 
# Figure 3: equal-sized 8-panel layout with fixed tags A–H
# 

library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(cowplot)


# Helper: add fixed panel tag

add_panel_tag <- function(p, tag_letter) {
  p +
    labs(tag = tag_letter) +
    theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
    )
}

# 
# Helper: pretty dbRDA plot with fixed nutrient label positions
# 

plot_dbrda_selected_pretty2 <- function(
    mod,
    env_df,
    term_table,
    title_text,
    palette_values,
    base_theme,
    sodium_lab_x_mult = 1.45,
    sodium_lab_y_mult = 1.55,
    sulfur_lab_x_mult = 1.18,
    sulfur_lab_y_mult = 1.18,
    norg_lab_x_mult   = 1.18,
    norg_lab_y_mult   = 1.18,
    mn_lab_x_mult     = 1.18,
    mn_lab_y_mult     = 1.18,
    mn_lab_y_add      = 0
) {
  
  site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(mod, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("row_id")
  colnames(site_scores)[2:3] <- c("CAP1", "CAP2")
  
  site_scores <- site_scores %>%
    mutate(
      sample_type = env_df$sample_type,
      nesting_site = env_df$nesting_site,
      sample_name = env_df$sample_name
    )
  
  bp_raw <- as.data.frame(scores(mod, display = "bp", choices = 1:2)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("variable_raw")
  colnames(bp_raw)[2:3] <- c("CAP1", "CAP2")
  
  bp_raw <- bp_raw %>%
    mutate(
      variable = stringr::str_remove_all(variable_raw, "log1p\\(|\\)")
    )
  
  term_pvals <- as.data.frame(term_table) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(term != "Residual") %>%
    transmute(
      variable = stringr::str_remove_all(term, "log1p\\(|\\)"),
      p_value = .data[["Pr(>F)"]]
    )
  
  bp_scores <- bp_raw %>%
    left_join(term_pvals, by = "variable") %>%
    mutate(
      variable_label = recode(variable, !!!nutrient_labels, .default = variable)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_value), p_value < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(
      CAP1 = CAP1 * 1.18,
      CAP2 = CAP2 * 1.18,
      lab_x = CAP1 * 1.18,
      lab_y = CAP2 * 1.18
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      lab_x = case_when(
  stringr::str_detect(variable_label, regex("^Sodium$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ CAP1 * sodium_lab_x_mult,
  stringr::str_detect(variable_label, regex("^Sulfur$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ CAP1 * sulfur_lab_x_mult,
  stringr::str_detect(variable_label, regex("^Organic nitrogen$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ CAP1 * norg_lab_x_mult,
  stringr::str_detect(variable_label, regex("^Manganese$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ CAP1 * mn_lab_x_mult,
  TRUE ~ lab_x
),
lab_y = case_when(
  variable == "na"      ~ CAP2 * sodium_lab_y_mult,
  variable == "s_icp"   ~ CAP2 * sulfur_lab_y_mult,
  variable == "norg_de" ~ CAP2 * norg_lab_y_mult,
  variable == "mn3"     ~ CAP2 * mn_lab_y_mult + mn_lab_y_add,
  TRUE ~ lab_y
)
    )
  
  eig_vals <- eigenvals(mod)
  axis1 <- round(100 * eig_vals[1] / sum(eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]), 1)
  axis2 <- round(100 * eig_vals[2] / sum(eig_vals[eig_vals > 0]), 1)
  
  p <- ggplot(site_scores, aes(x = CAP1, y = CAP2)) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      geom = "path",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      type = "norm",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = sample_type),
      size = 5.2,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = palette_values) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = paste0("dbRDA1 (", axis1, "%)"),
      y = paste0("dbRDA2 (", axis2, "%)")
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    )
  
  if (nrow(bp_scores) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_segment(
        data = bp_scores,
        aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = CAP1, yend = CAP2),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.20, "cm")),
        linewidth = 0.9,
        colour = "grey30",
        alpha = 0.95
      ) +
      geom_label(
        data = bp_scores,
        aes(x = lab_x, y = lab_y, label = variable_label),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 3.6,
        linewidth = 0,
        fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.88),
        colour = "grey15",
        label.r = unit(0.12, "lines"),
        label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines")
      )
  }
  
  p
}

# 
# Helper: mechanism plot
# 
plot_mechanism_adjusted2 <- function(points_df, pred_df, nutrient_name, ylab_text,
                                     line_type = "solid",
                                     palette_value,
                                     base_theme,
                                     line_alpha = 1) {
  
  pts <- points_df %>% filter(nutrient == nutrient_name)
  prd <- pred_df %>% filter(nutrient == nutrient_name)
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = pts,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, y = nutrient_value),
      colour = unname(palette_value),
      size = 4.6,
      alpha = 0.70
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = prd,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
      fill = unname(palette_value),
      alpha = 0.14
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = prd,
      aes(x = failed_eggs, y = fit),
      colour = unname(palette_value),
      linewidth = 1.2,
      linetype = line_type,
      alpha = line_alpha
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = nutrient_name,
      x = "Number of undeveloped eggs",
      y = ylab_text
    ) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
    )
}
```
